sloka: इदं राज्यमहं चैव भरतश्च सलक्ष्मणः ।आयत्तास्त्वं हि नो राजन्गतिश्च पुरुषर्षभ ।। ७.३८.१० ॥
transliteration: idaṁ rājyamahaṁ caiva bharataśca salakṣmaṇaḥ ।āyattāstvaṁ hi no rājangatiśca puruṣarṣabha ।। 7.38.10 ॥

translations.english: O King, O best among men, this kingdom, I, Bharata, and Lakshmana are all dependent on you, for you are indeed our refuge.
